fieldNotes.truckGate: Driveway from Forshee Dr is open with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch checkpoint. Two yellow bollards visible in the centerline (Street View 2025-03) appear to be lane-channelizing, not a vehicle barrier.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No occupied staffed guard booth visible at the gate apron in z20-z21 satellite. Small structure at entry appears to be a sign monument or utility cabinet, not a guard shack with multi-side windows.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No truck gate present, so by rubric this is false even though no shack exists either. Site reads as Archetype #3 (No Gate / No GS).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck loop south and east of building provides ample queueing once trucks turn off Forshee Dr.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal loop drive from Forshee entry to the east dock face is ~250m of paved travel — easily holds 3+ trucks in queue.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single property connection to public road network via Forshee Dr; trucks and cars share the entrance, then split inside.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single inbound lane at entry from Forshee.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: No gate, no apron, no extra lanes — concept does not apply; flagged false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~30 trailer-occupied or visible bays along east face plus ~6-8 along south face. Total estimated 35-40 doors → 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: SW-corner drop yard holds 10-13 trailers in marked stalls plus additional bobtail/trailer parking along south face; banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock clusters on different faces (east face large dock bank with ~30 trailers; south face smaller dock bank with ~6-8). Likely raw-material receiving vs. finished-goods shipping. Tagging true but flagging as uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-Jacksonville industrial fringe in heavy woods; only adjacent built parcels are other large industrial buildings (Walmart DC to south, etc.). Per rubric guidance, borderline industrial-with-woods → Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Despite Rural classification, this is Jacksonville metro fringe with continuous I-295 / industrial corridor coverage — LTE/5G should be solid. Flagged uncertain but defaulted false.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single building on the Kraft parcel. Neighboring large DC south of property is a separate company.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale pad visible anywhere on property.
fieldNotes.dropYard: SW-corner trailer-storage area is a clear dedicated drop yard (10-15 stalls) separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.multiStep: No second checkpoint stage — no gate at all.
